name: Canvas Engine UI
description: UI interaction spec for the infinite canvas engine. Core spatial interaction model: pan, zoom, card lifecycle, grid rendering, arrangement controls, layout overlay system with 8 snap zones.

dom.layout_overlays: .layout-overlay × 8 (48×36px thumbnail icons at viewport corners/edges, z-index:9999, hidden by default)

interactions.name: pan
interactions.trigger: Left-click drag on empty canvas area
interactions.behavior: Update panX/panY with delta from start position, throttled via requestAnimationFrame

interactions.name: pan_middle_button
interactions.trigger: Middle-click + drag on canvas
interactions.behavior: Same as left-click pan

interactions.name: zoom
interactions.trigger: Mouse wheel (no Ctrl)
interactions.behavior: Cursor-centered zoom — world point under cursor stays under cursor. zoom = clamp(zoom + direction * step, 0.1, 5.0)

interactions.name: zoom_fine
interactions.trigger: Ctrl + mouse wheel
interactions.behavior: Fine-grained zoom for precise adjustment

interactions.name: zoom_lock
interactions.trigger: Click lock icon in status bar or View > Zoom > Lock
interactions.behavior: Set canvas.locked to true, disables zoom interactions but allows pan. At scale===1 and locked, card drag reveals 8 layout snap overlays.

interactions.name: add_card
interactions.trigger: addTerminal/addExplorer/addGit/addMarkdown or right-click > New
interactions.behavior: Create PluginCard with plugin instance, snap to 28px grid, position at default offset or cascaded, push to z-order top, focus

interactions.name: card_focus
interactions.trigger: Click on card anywhere
interactions.behavior: Move card's UUID to end of zOrder array, increment z-index

interactions.name: card_close
interactions.trigger: Click terminate button (X) on card header
interactions.behavior: Remove card from canvas, destroy plugin instance, fire onStateChange

interactions.name: card_minimize
interactions.trigger: Click minimize button (—) on card header
interactions.behavior: Hide card body, set isOpen=false, update TopBar menu item to show dimmed

interactions.name: card_reopen
interactions.trigger: Click dimmed plugin item in TopBar View menu
interactions.behavior: Restore card to saved position and dimensions, set isOpen=true

interactions.name: fit_all_viewport
interactions.trigger: Click status bar 'view all' button or double-click card header
interactions.behavior: Calculate bounding box of all visible cards, compute zoom to fit with 40px padding, animate pan to center

interactions.name: fit_viewport_locked
interactions.trigger: Click .card-btn-fitview or double-click card header while zoom is locked
interactions.behavior: Resize target card to full viewport dimensions, then find a non-overlapping position via outward spiral scan (28px step, up to 10000px offset) from current position. Animates pan to center card at current zoom. Preserves zoom lock — does NOT change zoom level or auto-arrange other cards.

interactions.name: auto_arrange
interactions.trigger: Click 'Auto Arrange' in arrangement panel
interactions.behavior: Tile all open cards in a grid layout, default 2 columns, 800x550 sizing. Cards sorted by uuid for deterministic layout.

interactions.name: tile_plugins
interactions.trigger: Set WxH inputs in arrangement panel, click 'Tile Plugins'
interactions.behavior: Apply custom width/height to all open cards, re-arrange in grid. Shrinks to fit if needed (min 2 cols).

interactions.name: right_click_empty
interactions.trigger: Right-click on empty canvas area
interactions.behavior: ContextMenu with: New Terminal, New Explorer, New Git, New Markdown

interactions.name: snap_to_grid
interactions.trigger: All card position changes (drag end, auto arrange)
interactions.behavior: x = round(x / 28) * 28, y = round(y / 28) * 28

interactions.name: animated_pan
interactions.trigger: animatePanTo(targetX, targetY)
interactions.behavior: Ease-out cubic interpolation over 300ms: t => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3)

interactions.name: layout_overlay_show
interactions.trigger: Card drag start when locked && scale===1
interactions.behavior: Shows 8 snap zone overlays (48x36px thumbnail icons) at viewport corners and edges with SVG layout patterns. Hidden otherwise.

interactions.name: layout_overlay_hide
interactions.trigger: Card drag end (any location)
interactions.behavior: Hides all 8 overlay zones

interactions.name: layout_overlay_drop
interactions.trigger: Mouse release over visible overlay during card drag
interactions.behavior: Resizes card to zone dimensions (viewport fraction: corners = W/2×H/2, edges = W×H/2 or W/2×H), positions at viewport edge/corner in world coords. Snaps to 28px grid. Minimum 280px per dimension.

interactions.name: snap_origin
interactions.trigger: Click 'Snap Origin' in arrangement panel
interactions.behavior: Snaps panX/panY to nearest 28px grid point so viewport origin aligns to world grid. Ensures snap zone drops land on clean grid positions.

states.default: Grid visible (dots by default), zoom at 1.0, no cards
states.cards_open: One or more PluginCards visible with z-order stacking
states.minimized: Card header visible but body hidden, isOpen=false
states.locked: Zoom disabled, pan still works. At scale===1, card drag reveals layout overlays. Lock icon shown in status bar.
states.arranging: Cards being repositioned by auto-arrange, temporary transition state
